qualification: Cambridge Technical Extended Certificate in Business

qualification_scope.optional_unit_selection: Choose two 60 GLH units from Units 3, 5, 8, 11, 16, 17, 19, 20 and 21. Unit 3 is externally assessed; the other listed units are internally assessed.
qualification_scope.exam_leaf_scope: Units 1 and 2 are mandatory examination leaves. Unit 3 leaves are included as optional externally examined reference content and are not qualification-mandatory. Unit 4 is mandatory internal assessment and is intentionally absent from examination leaves.
evidence: OCR Units page identifies Extended Certificate, 360 GLH, QN 601/7699/4; mandatory units include Unit 1, Unit 2 and Unit 4; two 60 GLH optional units are selected from Units 3, 5, 8, 11, 16, 17, 19, 20 and 21.

The same page identifies Unit 3 Business decisions as externally assessed (E), Unit 4 Customers and communication as internally assessed (I), and Units 5, 8, 11, 16, 17, 19, 20 and 21 as internally assessed (I).
